name: detects_available_shells
expected_patterns: which shell|what shell|shell do you use
description: Skill should detect available shells and ask user to choose

name: handles_already_installed
description: When kiro-launcher is already in ~/.zshrc, skill should detect and inform user

name: offers_rc_configuration
prompt: I just installed kiro-launcher, now configure it
description: Skill should offer to configure projects directory and Kiro flags

name: auto_detects_project_dirs
description: Skill should offer to configure projects directory and show current state

name: handles_per_project_flags
prompt: I want different flags for my-app project
description: Skill should guide user through per-project flag configuration

name: writes_config_file
prompt: yes, my projects are in ~/dev, use --trust-all-tools as default flags, no per-project overrides
description: Skill should write the config file and confirm what was written

name: verifies_kiro_cli_on_path
description: Skill should check if kiro-cli is available and warn if not
